correctness.rationale: For every squarefree N>=6 and p its LEAST prime divisor, a vanishing sum of <=p N-th roots is necessarily one rotated p-gon of length p. The induction strips primes q>p using that only relation among q roots over the smaller cyclotomic field is their all-ones relation, and fewer than q summands leave a missing q-coordinate. Orthogonality forces A,B each to be mod-p transversals and, independently at each q|N/p, at least one q-coordinate vector constant. Under the CRT, I is the tensor product of M_q=1_{u constant or v constant}; its active 2-dimensional block [[q,sqrt(q(q^p-q))],[sqrt(...),0]] has roots (q+-sqrt(4q^(p+1)-3q^2))/2. All remaining q^p-2 dimensions are kernel. Hence rank 2^{omega(N)-1} and ordered pair count product_q(2q^(p+1)-q^2). Covers p=2, two prime factors, accidental eigenvalue coincidences.
